messages:
Mia (CS): Quick sync — Harbor‑Neo finished onboarding tests in EU yesterday and ran into a hard rate cap during synthetic load. They asked for a temporary lift + IP allowlist while they ramp to prod. Renewal is coming up in ~6 weeks so we want a smooth demo.
Omar (AM): Thx Mia. They want a 48h burst to 600 rps from eu-west-1, then back to normal. CTO says traffic will originate from a small set of IPs behind their proxy.
Tim (Ops): Do we have capacity headroom for an account bump to 600 rps for 48h in eu-west-1? If so we can set an auto-revoke at T+48h. Suggest adding a soft throttle rather than permanent on-call changes.
Jen (Infra): I can do an allowlist + temporary rate window. Need exact CIDRs and whether requests come with client TLS or via an upstream NAT/proxy. Also: do they need region pinning to eu-west-1 or is multi-region ok?
Mia (CS): CIDRs provided by customer: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.12/32. Traffic routes through proxy.harbor-neo.internal (TLS terminated there). They prefer eu-west-1 pin for latency during the demo.
Jen (Infra): Ok. I'll prepare an ephemeral policy. Proposed config:

```
account: harbor-neo (id: 8921)
allowlist:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
  - 198.51.100.12/32
rate_limit_override:
  region: eu-west-1
  burst_rps: 600
  duration: 48h
  auto_revoke: true
```

Jen (Infra): Will need a signed ticket and AM approval in thread to proceed. Also confirm they are using API keys and not IP allowlist-only restrictions.
Omar (AM): Confirmed they use API keys + our standard auth. I'll file the ticket now and DM the signed approval from their security lead. Also flagged renewal team to mention successful ramp if all goes well.
Tim (Ops): Once ticket is in, I can apply the config and set monitoring alerts for token-level spike and tail latency. Suggest: create a dashboard and a one-hour runbook check at t+2h, t+12h, t+36h.
Mia (CS): I'll run the enablement call with their platform engineer during the change window (tomorrow 09:00 UTC). I'll collect feedback items to ensure there are no regressions in prompt throughput or errors.
SRE-Bot: Incident create request: creating temporary-rate-override ticket #T-1758642 with owner Jen (Infra) and auto-revoke 48h. React with :thumbsup: to approve.
Omar (AM): Reacted :thumbsup: — customer security lead signed the approval doc (I uploaded to the ticket).
Jen (Infra): Applying the allowlist & rate override at the scheduled window. Will post back when done and when auto-revoke is set. ETA 09:05 UTC tomorrow to start.
Tim (Ops): I'll add the dashboard: harbor-neo / acct-8921 / eu-west-1: tokens/sec, 99p latency, error rate. Set alerts: >75% of burst for 5m and error rate >1% for 3 consecutive checks.
Mia (CS): Thanks all — next steps: Omar confirm signed doc in ticket, Jen apply config during window, Tim monitor and call out any anomalies, I'll run enablement and capture feedback from their platform lead. I'll drop a short post-mortem if anything unexpected pops up.
Omar (AM): I'll follow up with renewal team about potential case study if the ramp goes well — nice win opportunity.
SRE-Bot: Ticket #T-1758642 updated: status -> scheduled. Auto-revoke scheduled at 1758814801.
